info.title: Zumper Rentals API: US Apartment Rentals + Rent Change Monitor
info.description:
Zumper listings JSON by US city: rent, beds, address, pet policy, lead score. Rent change monitor returns only new listings and rent drops.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/zumper-rentals (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Zumper API for apartments and houses for rent by US city: address, rent range, beds, baths, amenities, pet policy, phone, agent and brokerage, coordinates and a 0-100 lead score. Up to 10 listings per request, as JSON.

mode.title: Scraping Mode
mode.description: Choose whether to search listings or scrape specific URLs

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: One or more Zumper city slugs to search, city then state (e.g. 'san-francisco-ca', 'new-york-ny', 'austin-tx'). Each is searched on its own with the filters below, and Maximum Listings applies per location.

location.title: Location (single, older field)
location.description: One city slug, e.g. 'san-francisco-ca'. Kept so saved inputs keep working; it is searched together with Locations.

minPrice.title: Minimum Price
minPrice.description: Include properties with an available unit at or above this monthly rent

maxPrice.title: Maximum Price
maxPrice.description: Include properties with an available unit at or below this monthly rent in USD.

minBeds.title: Minimum Bedrooms
minBeds.description: Lowest accepted bedroom count (0 includes studios)

airbnbFriendly.title: Airbnb-Friendly Only
airbnbFriendly.description: Use Zumper's verified Airbnb-friendly feature filter

listingUrls.title: Listing URLs
listingUrls.description: Direct Zumper listing URLs to scrape (for direct_urls mode)

maxListings.title: Maximum Listings
maxListings.description: Listings to return. A request returns 10 listings at most.

maxPages.title: Result pages per search
maxPages.description: Result pages to read. Zumper serves 10 listings per result page.

includePhotos.title: Include Photo IDs
includePhotos.description: Include Zumper photo IDs and photo count for each listing

onlyChanges.title: Only New and Changed Listings
onlyChanges.description: Rent-change watch: return only listings that are new or whose rent or details changed since the last request with the same monitorId. Unchanged listings are left out.

monitorId.title: Monitor ID
monitorId.description: Name of your watch, up to 80 characters. Watches are kept by this name across all callers of this API, so use a long random name only you know, and one name per search.

firstRunMode.title: First Run
firstRunMode.description: First request of a new watch: emitAll returns the current listings as new, seedOnly only stores them as the starting point and returns an empty list.

resetState.title: Reset Selected Monitor
resetState.description: Start this watch again from the current listings. Send it once, then leave it out.

201.description: The results, one object per row.

example.name: Blueground San Francisco
example.address: 149 San Francisco New Montgomery St #1161, San Francisco, CA 94105

400.description: The request body does not fit the input fields. The message says which field.
